goal: Stop nodes from self-advertising Tor exit and proxy IP addresses learned from outbound peers
Prevents network address tables from filling with unreachable exit nodes that cause failed connection attempts
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Concept support because advertising unreachable addresses provides no value (0xB10C, naiyoma)
Suggests checking whether a connection is proxied before validating peer address (naiyoma)
Suggests preventing outbound peers from reflecting their own address back to us (naiyoma)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it stops nodes from gossiping unreachable proxy and Tor exit node IP addresses across the network
Reduces address manager pollution that currently leads nodes to attempt doomed connections to exit nodes
